title: Untwisted diagonal restriction commutator
statement: For the untwisted base pullback, the diagonal pullback of the inverse ambient square comparison followed by the first section identification equals the second section identification.

source.place: Second identity, first factor before the Tate twist.

proof.text: Use the strictly simpler conjugated comparison: rewrite the ambient comparison restriction by this equation, then cancel the first pull-section isomorphism using its inverse.

proof_origin.place: Second identity, first factor before the Tate twist.
proof_origin.note: The proof combines the conjugated comparison with the inverse section isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem second_pull_section_core_comm
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X Y)) :
    (moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (diagonalImmersion Y)).map
        ((ambientPullbackComparison (coefficient l c).X (square Y)).symm.app K).inv ≫
      (pullSectionIso (coefficient l c).X Y (firstProjection Y)
        (by unfold firstProjection; exact pullback.diagonal_fst _)).hom.app
        ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X
          (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj K) =
      (pullSectionIso (coefficient l c).X Y (secondProjection Y)
        (by unfold secondProjection; exact pullback.diagonal_snd _)).hom.app
        ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X
          (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj K)
